payload.progression_strategy: Volume- and variation-based progression per research.json's advanced/minimal-equipment finding: since simple load jumps are limited by kettlebell/band/bodyweight-only equipment, progress via added reps first, then tempo (slower eccentrics), then reduced rest for metabolic stress, with an extra top-up set added in the final push (weeks 10-12) after the week-9 deload.
